evidence.s1_ci: ci.yml runs `npm ci`, `npm test` (with the `pretest` prepare-data step) and `npm run build` in site/; all three exist in app/site/package.json. It triggers on `pull_request` only, sets `permissions: contents: read`, uses no secrets and warns against `pull_request_target`. pr-title.yml uses `permissions: {}` and passes the title through an env var. pages.yml deploys on `push: branches: [main]` plus `workflow_dispatch`. release.yml runs on tags, with `contents: write` scoped to the job and only `github.token`. Problems: every action is pinned to a major tag, not a full commit SHA (`actions/checkout@v7`, `setup-node@v7`, `configure-pages@v6`, `upload-pages-artifact@v5`, `deploy-pages@v5`; step1.patch lines 86, 88, 138, 148, 165, 179). pages.yml grants `pages: write` and `id-token: write` to the whole workflow, so the build job that runs `npm ci`/`npm test` gets them too; only the deploy job needs them. `workflow_dispatch` lets the deploy run from any branch, unless an environment rule stops it. Nothing was pushed or run.
evidence.s1_readme: README (step1.patch lines 484-602) covers install (`cd site`, `npm ci`, Node 22 from .nvmrc), develop (`npm run dev`), a table of the other scripts (index, fieldsets, prepare-data, sample-bullets), test (`npm test`), build (`npm run build`, `npm run preview`, `PAGES_BASE=/OpenBallistics/ npm run build`, which matches vite.config.ts:11), contributing with a pointer to CONTRIBUTING.md for data rules, and the licence (MIT, which matches app/LICENSE). Every command shown exists in site/package.json. Linked files exist: LICENSE, THIRD-PARTY.md, data/bullets/README.md, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE.
evidence.s1_release: There is one strategy and it is consistent. The version lives in `site/package.json` (already 0.1.0). A release is a `vX.Y.Z` tag on main. release.yml checks that the tag matches package.json, is on main and has a `## [X.Y.Z] - ` changelog section, then publishes the notes and the data/site tarballs. CHANGELOG.md states Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 and SemVer, and docs/releasing.md gives the bump rules and the step-by-step process. dependabot.yml covers npm in /site and github-actions, with commit prefixes `build(deps)`/`ci(deps)` that match the convention. CONTRIBUTING.md states Conventional Commits with a type table. All seven commits in commits.txt follow it. Minor: docs/releasing.md links to docs/agents/triage-labels.md, which is not in app/docs.
evidence.s2_requirements: Route: router.ts parses `#/compare/<a>/<b>`, splitting before decoding, and App.svelte renders Compare.svelte, so it survives a reload. Drawing: one SVG with `role="img"` and `aria-label` 'Profiles of {a} and {b}' built from the record names (`first.name`). It holds two `<path>` outlines from `caseOuterProfile(adaptMetallic(..))` in one `viewportFor` at scale 1, so both share one axis and head face. Shot cartridges are excluded with a note. Table: `<caption>` reads Dimensions (mm)/(in); headers are Symbol, name A, name B, Difference; symbols come from FIELD_LABELS; FIELD_UNITS fields and `Tol` fields are excluded; only the cartridge part is read; Difference is B minus A. Units follow `unitSystem()`, the same store GlobalSettings uses, through formatValue or displayNumber('in'). Cartridge.svelte adds a labelled `Compare with` NativeSelect of the other entries sorted by name and a `Compare` button that opens `href.compare(key, chosen)`. German strings were added for every key. All requirements are met.
evidence.s2_correctness: compare.ts values come straight from the record. `difference()` removes binary noise (`12.07-11.9` gives 0.17) without dropping real precision. Imperial values and differences go through `displayNumber(v,'in')` with no further rounding. Symbols are deduplicated, and zero is kept as a published value. Records that cannot be drawn (adaptMetallic throws) fall back to a note. Defect: the head-face guide is a zero-length line. In compare.ts `head: [headX, topY, headX, centreY + view.rMax]`, `topY = view.xy(view.rMax,0)[1]` works out to rMax+rMax+margin, which equals `centreY + rMax`, so the head-face guide is never drawn (it should run from `xy(-rMax,0)`). The test checks only `overlay.head[0]`. The outlines themselves are still aligned at the head.
evidence.s2_fit: It reuses lib/core (FIELD_LABELS, FIELD_UNITS, GROUP_ORDER, orderedFields, formatValue), lib/geom (viewportFor, fullSectionPath, fmt), lib/shapes2d (adaptMetallic, caseOuterProfile), site units.ts/units.svelte.ts, and the PageHeader, ScaleRuler, NativeSelect, Label and Button components. It follows the lazy-chunk route pattern, the `@layer legacy` scoped styles and the i18n en/de tables, and adds metadata and nav entries. Some duplication: `dimensionsOf` re-implements the known-then-sorted group ordering of `orderedGroups` in site/src/lib/fields.ts, and Compare.svelte copies GroupTable's table CSS. One unneeded edit to CONTRIBUTING.md (the key note).
evidence.s2_tests: site/src/lib/compare.test.ts follows the repo's Vitest pure-logic style. It tests `difference` (float noise, zero, sign), the dimension rows against the real 308 Win./300 Win. Mag. records (e min, E1 values, exclusion of Tol, pressures and angles, cartridge part only), `showLength` in both systems, and `overlayOf` (one scale, a common axis, aligned head faces, shot and undrawable records). router.test.ts adds parse and round-trip cases and malformed URLs. Gaps: the repo has no component-test setup, so the Cartridge select/button and the SVG/table markup are untested, and the overlay test misses the degenerate head-face line.
evidence.s3_fixes: Point 1: `sharedDimensions` becomes `allDimensions`, which merges both orders. Rows have `a`, `b` and `difference` as `null` where a record is silent, and Compare.svelte renders those cells empty. Tests assert `delta L` {a:0.1,b:null} and `R3` {a:null,b:13.51}, plus ordering and no-shared cases. The en/de lede and 'none' texts are updated to match, and the changelog entry is amended. Point 2: step 3 makes no CSS change. The step 2 styles already right-align th/td except the first column (`th, td { text-align: right }` and `th:first-child, td:first-child { text-align: left }`, same as GroupTable.svelte), so the final state meets the request. However, the step 3 commit (`fix(site): list dimensions that only one compared cartridge publishes`) covers only point 1 and leaves no record that point 2 was checked. No regressions seen.
evidence.cross_step: Step 2 adds a line under `## [Unreleased]` / `### Added`. Step 3 amends that line, which is right because the feature is unreleased. No version bump, which matches docs/releasing.md (the version is set only at release). Commits `feat(site): …` and `fix(site): …` follow Conventional Commits and the pr-title regex. The code looks type-correct for svelte-check (null-guarded `showLength` calls, `Record_.name` exists) and existing tests are only extended, so the CI checks should pass. I did not run them.

unmet_requirements: Step 1 / s1_ci criterion: actions are pinned to major-version tags (`@v7`, `@v6`, `@v5`), not full commit SHAs
Step 1 / s1_ci criterion: pages.yml grants `pages: write` and `id-token: write` at workflow level, including the build job, not least privilege
strengths: The compare view meets every step 2 requirement and reuses `caseOuterProfile`, `viewportFor`/`fullSectionPath`, FIELD_LABELS/FIELD_UNITS, `formatValue` and `displayNumber` instead of new geometry or formatting code

Coherent release setup: the version lives in site/package.json, a tag workflow checks the tag against the version, main and the changelog, Keep a Changelog is documented, Dependabot prefixes match Conventional Commits, and every commit follows the convention
The step 3 bug fix is clean and well tested (`allDimensions` with null cells, order merging, delta L/R3 cases), with matching changelog and i18n updates
issues: Workflow actions are not pinned to commit SHAs (checkout, setup-node, configure-pages, upload-pages-artifact, deploy-pages all use `@vN`), and pages.yml gives `pages`/`id-token: write` to the build job as well
The overlay's head-face guide is a zero-length line (`head` y1 == y2 in compare.ts overlayOf), so the head-face marker never draws, and the test does not catch it

Step 3 point 2 (right alignment) has no change or commit note. The step 2 CSS already right-aligned the cells, but the commit records only the first fix. Minor duplication of `orderedGroups` ordering and GroupTable CSS in the feature
review.verdict: This is solid work: the compare feature and its follow-up fix are correct, well tested and well integrated, and the release, README and commit conventions are consistent and followed. Before merging, pin the workflow actions to SHAs, scope the Pages permissions to the deploy job, and fix the zero-length head-face guide.
